node.title: Perl substitute with the nth match
node.author: misterperl
node.doctext:
Apologies if this has been answered here or elsewhere; I did research, but it's one of those hard-to-describe questions for a SE..

Briefly I need to substitute the ordinal match sequence number for each match, like: cat dog cat mouse eel cat housecat catamaran fish I need a perlvar that has the nth match so I can write something like s/(cat)/^1/smg where ^1 would be the number of the nth "cat": matched. In that example I'd get: 1 dog 2 mouse eel 3 house4 5amaran fish OF COURSE I can do this in a loop. Or with a /e.. I want a substitution with a Perlvar of the nth match, if one exists? TYVM!
